title: Sami shaman's Amanita muscaria winter-solstice ritual

tellings.quote: And then this shaman or this healer would travel with reindeer to collect these mushrooms and he would dry it over a fireplace.

plain: Among the Sami, the native people of Lapland in the far north of Europe, a shaman or healer is said to have travelled with reindeer at the winter solstice to gather fly agaric, the red and white mushroom known as Amanita muscaria, and then dried it over a fireplace. A mushroom writer and entrepreneur named Tero Isokauppila tells this to Michels as lore from the region, without naming a source. It is told as an old ritual use of the mushroom in the far north.
